sources.text: CAPI Machine owns infrastructure through an AzureMachine. Control plane initialization precedes worker readiness. The collector writes machine cloud-init logs under artifacts/clusters/{cluster}/machines/{machine}/cloud-init-output.log.

architecture.text: CAPI Machine reconciliation delegates infrastructure provisioning to AzureMachine resources.

diagnostic_lifecycle.text: Diagnose infrastructure provisioning, bootstrap completion, control plane initialization, then node readiness from timestamped conditions and logs.

test_flavors.text: Jobs select Linux, Windows, and MachinePool templates; identify the actual template from job metadata.

artifacts.purpose: Shows bootstrap commands and cloud-init failures for one machine.

failure_patterns.name: Bootstrap command failure
failure_patterns.signal: cloud-init reports a nonzero bootstrap command
failure_patterns.do_not_conclude: Do not infer an Azure API defect from a node readiness timeout alone.
failure_patterns.remediation_limit: Recommend code or template changes only when the failing command and owner are established.

transient_rules.only_if: A timestamped retry succeeds and reconciliation progresses during the run.
transient_rules.not_transient_if: Throttling persists, credentials are invalid, quota remains exhausted, or reconciliation never progresses.

triage_order.text: After build-log and JUnit, identify the template, inspect Machine and AzureMachine conditions, then read the matching machine bootstrap log.

unresolved: Confirm the exact controller log path emitted by each job flavor.
